answer: An identity bond decaying like karst under slow water stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a jade token worth 60 POA, and the bond bridges the agent to the network's shared work. It loses 5 POA per epoch, so after 12 epochs it is gone and renewal is required to stay. A farmer with 100 fake identities pays 6,000 POA and watches it drain away. An honest agent pays one 60 POA bond, keeps its seat, and earns undiluted rewards while the fakes bleed.
